paragraphs: If your SLC250 is a 2016-2020 model with the M270 or M274 4-cylinder petrol - that's the R172 generation - timing chain wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine family, shared with the C-Class of the same era. We replace the timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every SLC250 rebuild.
